info.title: AI Engineering from Scratch public resources
info.description: Read-only, public machine-readable resources for the AI Engineering from Scratch curriculum. Lesson source remains canonical in the GitHub repository. No authentication is required. REST uses /api/v1/ and X-API-Version: 1. Additive changes preserve v1; breaking changes require a new major path. Retirement requires a migration guide and RFC 9745 Deprecation and RFC 8594 Sunset headers with at least 90 days notice. See /docs for quotas and MCP transport details.

/api/v1/markdown.description: Version 1 of the public navigation-page representation API. /api/markdown remains a compatible alias. Additive changes preserve v1; breaking representation changes require a new versioned path. Only GET and HEAD are supported. No per-client rate quota is advertised or enforced by this handler.
